import sys

def main():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not input_data:
        return
    
    n = int(input_data[0])
    L = [int(x) for x in input_data[1:n+1]]
    
    i = 0
    j = n - 1
    left_sum = L[i]
    right_sum = L[j]
    ops = 0
    
    while i < j:
        if left_sum == right_sum:
            i += 1
            j -= 1
            left_sum = L[i]
            right_sum = L[j]
        elif left_sum < right_sum:
            i += 1
            left_sum += L[i]
            ops += 1
        else:
            j -= 1
            right_sum += L[j]
            ops += 1
            
    print(ops)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
